title: Migrate snapshot export records from TypedDict to dataclasses
description:
Replace the snapshot-layer export records in `schemas/game_export_types.py` with dataclasses: `SnapshotPlayer`, `CombatGroup`, and `Snapshot`.

This should come after the board-and-stack leaf record migration. Keep the PR focused on snapshot construction, loading, and consumers in timeline, rendering, and analysis code. Do not include `GameExport`, `BuiltGameExport`, or decision-layer migrations in the same PR.

Review target: one coherent snapshot data model migration with localized call-site churn.
